youtube.title: Why The Moon Never Shows Its Back 🌙 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
The Moon always shows the same face to Earth because of tidal locking. It rotates once on its axis in the same time it takes to orbit Earth, about 27 days. Long ago the Moon spun faster, but Earth's gravity pulled on its slightly uneven shape and slowed the rotation until it matched the orbit. This is why the far side is never visible from Earth.
